bullets.text: Camera Showdown: iPhone vs. Galaxy - **iPhone 17 Pro** and **Galaxy S25 Ultra** excel in photography, but personal preference reigns.
New Drama Alert: Apple TV - **Apple TV** debuts **Down Cemetery Road**, keeping subscribers engaged post **Slow Horses**.
CarPlay Gets a Boost - **iOS 26** introduces widgets to **CarPlay**, enhancing user experience with glanceable info.
TechCrunch Disrupt Highlights - **TechCrunch Disrupt 2025** showcased innovative startups and key industry insights.
AI Features Return in iOS - **iOS 26** reinstates controversial AI notification summaries, aiming for improved accuracy.
Microsoft's AI Ambitions - **GitHub** aims to be the hub for AI coding agents, enhancing developer workflows.
Spotify Revamps Apple TV App - **Spotify** launches a new **Apple TV 4K** app with enhanced features and performance.
Navan's IPO Struggles - **Navan** sees a 20% drop on its first trading day, raising concerns over regulatory scrutiny.
AI Expansion at Apple - **Tim Cook** announces plans to integrate more AI tools into **Apple's** ecosystem.
Nvidia's Big Bet - **Nvidia** reportedly invests up to $1 billion in **Poolside**, focusing on AI model development.
